svg.title: Phase 4, Fix loop: a bounded ring with gates
svg.desc: Open findings go around a ring at most four times, the budget kept on disk. The round counter opens a round; routing gives each finding a rung on the editing ladder, cheap for a minor finding with a proven fence, never cheap for a blocker, a security finding, or a flagged file, one lever up on a retry; the editor makes one commit per finding, replies, and pushes; the project's check gate must pass, with one repair allowed and a second failure parking the run; the verifier executes Check lines and judges each Resolution verbatim, resolving threads or reopening them with notes; a skim sends files no finding named to an incremental review; and the count decides: open findings go around again, a finding reopened past the limit gets one arbitration and then parks, four spent rounds park with a status comment, and none open converges, a wont-fix needing your yes before anything merges.
svg.text: The agent that writes code cannot close findings; the agent that closes them cannot write code.
the orchestrating session sees one line per script

text.tspan: edit all rung cheap model sonnet effort medium reason mechanical ids F001 F004

g.text: opens a round, four at most

svg.text: A minor or nit with a proven fence starts on the cheap rung.
A blocker, a security finding, or a flagged file never starts cheap.
A retry moves one lever, effort first, then the model, under the
The editor cannot resolve a thread; the verifier cannot edit a file.
The skim reviews changes no finding asked for.
Arbitration is one strong pass, once a run.

g.text: the editor again, one lever up
never merges over a red gate
a note says what still fails
a wont-fix needs your yes first
a status comment names what is open

svg.text: agent: a model with its own context
its model rung and effort, routed by a script
a fallback; the run goes on
stops or parks; a number is the exit code
